## Course description

Sociology studies how groups, institutions, and broader social forces influence individuals, and how individuals shape the society around them. In this course, we will use sociological concepts, theories, and evidence to examine familiar parts of life from a new angle.

Read the full course description, learning outcomes, assessments, and policies in the [course syllabus](syllabus.qmd).
